about.title: A Professional Partner for Your Next Idea.
about.lead: King Business Studio helps businesses and individuals present their work clearly — through documents, design and websites that look professional and are built to be used.
about.aboutText:
King Business Studio (KBS) is a business studio that works across three areas: professional business documents, graphic design, and web development. The work ranges from a single CV or a logo, through to company profiles, brand materials and complete websites.

The approach is straightforward. We listen to what the business is trying to achieve, agree a clear scope, and then do the work properly. Nothing is presented as finished until it has been reviewed and the scope has been confirmed.
about.missionText: To deliver practical, professional, and creative solutions that help our clients communicate and grow.
about.visionText: To become a trusted partner for business and digital solutions in Rwanda and beyond.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: Work that looks considered, reads clearly and can be relied on.

values.title: Clarity
values.description: Plain explanations of what will be delivered, what it costs and what is still open.

values.title: Practicality
values.description: Solutions that solve the actual problem rather than adding complexity.

values.title: Creativity
values.description: Design decisions made for the audience, not for decoration.

values.title: Respect
values.description: Honest timelines, honest feedback and respect for your time.

about.approachText: Every project starts with a conversation and ends with a clear handover. Between those two points, the scope stays visible so that decisions are made deliberately.
approachSteps: We listen before we suggest anything.
We explain the options in plain language.
We agree the scope, pricing and timeline in writing.
We share work in progress so nothing is a surprise.
We deliver files and guidance you can actually use.

about.ctaText: Tell us what you are trying to achieve and we will review the details.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | King Business Studio
meta.description: How King Business Studio collects, uses and handles information submitted through this website.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: King Business Studio ("KBS", "we", "us") provides business document, graphic design and web development services. This policy explains what happens to information you send through this website.

The business name, registered address and contact email for the data controller are still being finalised and will be added here before the website is published. Until then, the contact form on the Contact page is the way to reach us.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: When you submit the service request or contact form, we collect the details you type in: your name, your email address, the country you give, your preferred language, and the project information you provide. These fields are marked on the form and only the ones marked as required are mandatory.
We do not ask for passwords, payment card details, national identification numbers or any other sensitive personal information, and we ask that you do not include them in a message.

The support assistant runs entirely in your browser. Your chat messages are held in the memory of the open page only. They are not sent to a server, they are not stored in a database, and they are not sent to any external AI provider.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: Information you submit is used to review your request, to prepare a quotation and scope, and to reply to you. We use it for that purpose and for nothing else.
We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: Formspree
paragraphs: Both forms are delivered using Formspree, a third-party form handling service. When you submit a form, the information you entered is sent to Formspree, which forwards it to the KBS inbox so we can reply. Formspree processes this information on our behalf under its own privacy terms.

You can read Formspree's own privacy policy at formspree.io. If you would rather not send information through a third-party service, please tell us that in the message and we will arrange another way to receive it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiry information is kept for as long as needed to deal with your request and to maintain a record of the business correspondence. Once a project is complete, we keep only what is needed for accounting and legal obligations.
The exact retention period is being confirmed and will be stated here once the business's record-keeping policy is finalised.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted, using the contact details on the Contact page. You can also ask us to stop using your details for follow-up.
You can clear the support assistant conversation at any time using the "Clear conversation" control inside the chat panel.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: This website does not set advertising cookies and does not run third-party advertising trackers. Your language preference is stored locally in your own browser so that the site remembers which language you selected.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The website is served over HTTPS in production, and the forms are delivered over an encrypted connection. No system can be guaranteed to be completely secure, so please avoid sending anything you would not want disclosed.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy is updated when the way the site works changes. The "Last updated" date above shows the most recent revision.

meta.title: Terms of Use | King Business Studio
meta.description: The terms that apply when you use the King Business Studio website.

sections.title: About these terms
paragraphs: These terms apply to everyone who uses the King Business Studio website. By using the site you accept them.
The business name, registered address, governing law and jurisdiction are still being finalised and will be completed here before the website is published.

sections.title: What this website is for
paragraphs: This site presents King Business Studio's services and work, and provides forms for requesting a service or getting in touch. We may update the content of the site at any time.

sections.title: No guarantees
paragraphs: Content on this site, including the service descriptions and the projects shown, is provided for general information. Unless a written quotation has been issued for a specific project, nothing on this site is an offer, a price or a commitment to a result.
We do not guarantee employment, investment, funding, contracts, search rankings, revenue or any particular performance outcome for any work we produce.

sections.title: Projects and quotations
paragraphs: A project only begins once the scope, pricing and timeline have been agreed in writing. Pricing shown on request forms is indicative of the categories of budget discussed during the quotation, and is not a fixed price.
Work shown in the portfolio includes concept and demo projects created by KBS to demonstrate capabilities. They are labelled as such and are not presented as client engagements.

sections.title: Your content and conduct
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the content you send us. You confirm that you have the right to send it, and that doing so does not infringe anyone else's rights.
You agree not to use the site to send unlawful, abusive or harmful material, and not to attempt to disrupt or gain unauthorised access to the site.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The design, text, code and branding of this website belong to King Business Studio unless stated otherwise. You may view the site and print pages for your own reference. You may not reproduce it commercially without written permission.
Ownership of work produced for a client is set out in the written agreement for that project.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: The site uses Formspree to deliver form submissions and Google Fonts to provide web fonts. Their use is subject to their own terms and privacy policies.

The support assistant is a rule-based system that answers from the information published on this site. It is not a person and it does not use a generative AI model. Information it provides should be confirmed before you rely on it.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, King Business Studio is not liable for loss arising from the use of this website or reliance on information published on it. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: Contact
